Hi Ellen —

Congrats again on finishing the three-week pilot with our optimized serving config. The results you shared (45% faster personalization inference, ~27% cost reduction on peak hourly load) are exactly the kind of story that helps late-stage retailers evaluate operational impact.

We'd love to capture a short, 30-minute UX & outcomes session with you next week to:
- Record a quick walkthrough of how the feature is used in-store/dashboard flows (30 min)
- Pull a 1–2 sentence quote for a one-page case snapshot
- Ask permission to include one anonymized chart and a short blurb in a customer case study

Logistics: we can schedule a 30-minute Zoom; we would ask for a few screens shared (POS dashboard, sample query). We also have a short recording consent form and a case-template to make the process easy. If you prefer, we can do an audio-only—whatever's simplest.

Proposed windows (CEST):
- Thu 17 Sep, 09:00–12:00
- Fri 18 Sep, 14:00–17:00

We can send a draft quote ahead of time for you to review. For compliance, if your legal team wants an NDA or redline, we're happy to accept a signed minimal NDA (I've cc'd Marissa to coordinate).

Thanks — really excited to showcase Stratos's results.

Best,
Jordan Blake
